title: ParsHate: A Benchmark Dataset for Hate and Target Detection in Persian
abstract: arXiv:2609.16393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce ParsHate, a manually annotated dataset of 10,000 Persian tweets spanning 2013-2022, representing the first decade-long benchmark for hate speech detection in Persian. The dataset contains 31% hateful content and supports both hate detection and multi-label fine-grained target identification across seven structured target categories. ParsHate also distinguishes explicit and implicit hate, marks explicit and implicit targets, and provides span-level rationales. Data collection combines random and score-stratified temporal sampling to reduce keyword-driven bias while preserving natural label distributions. Applying SOTA models for Persian hate-speech detection on ParsHate shows moderate performance (79% F1), especially with samples from earlier years, and low performance with target identification (25.5% macro-F1). translated_title: ParsHate：一个用于波斯语仇恨言论与目标检测的基准数据集
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了ParsHate，一个包含10,000条波斯语推文的手动标注数据集，时间跨度为2013至2022年，是首个涵盖十年数据的波斯语仇恨言论检测基准数据集。该数据集包含31%的仇恨内容，支持仇恨检测和多标签细粒度目标识别，涵盖七个结构化的目标类别。ParsHate还区分显性与隐性仇恨，标记显性与隐性目标，并提供跨度级别的判断依据。数据收集采用随机采样与按分数分层的时间采样相结合的方式，以减少关键词驱动的偏差，同时保持自然的标签分布。将最先进的波斯语仇恨言论检测模型应用于ParsHate的结果显示，其性能仅为中等水平（79% F1），尤其是在较早年份的样本上表现较差，而目标识别的性能则较低（25.5% macro-F1）。这凸显了ParsHate中仇恨言论采样的多样性及其挑战性，表明该任务需要更先进的……
tldr: ParsHate是首个涵盖2013-2022十年间数据的波斯语仇恨言论检测基准数据集，包含手动标注的10,000条推文，支持仇恨检测与细粒度目标识别，实验表明现有最先进模型在该数据集上性能仍有较大提升空间。
en_tdlr: ParsHate is the first decade-long (2013-2022) benchmark dataset for Persian hate speech detection, comprising 10,000 manually annotated tweets supporting both hate detection and fine-grained target identification, on which existing SOTA models achieve only moderate to low performance.
